name: Envelope
description: Represents an envelope attached to a document.
remarks: Use the Envelope property to return the Envelope object. The following example adds an envelope to a new document and sets the distance between the top of the envelope and the address to 2.25 inches. Remarks The Envelope object is available regardless of whether an envelope has been added to the specified document. However, an error occurs if you use one of the following properties when an envelope has not been added to the document: Address, AddressFromLeft, AddressFromTop, FeedSource, ReturnAddress, ReturnAddressFromLeft, ReturnAddressFromTop, and UpdateDocument. The following example demonstrates how to use the On Error GoTo statement to trap the error that occurs if an envelope has not been added to the active document. If, however, an envelope has been added to the document, the recipient address is displayed. Use the Insert method to add an envelope to the specified document. Use the PrintOut method to set the properties of an envelope and print it without adding it to the document.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Envelope object.

properties.name: Address
properties.description: Returns the envelope delivery address as a Range object. Read-only.

properties.name: ReturnAddress
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the envelope return address.

properties.name: DefaultPrintFIMA
properties.description: True to add a Facing Identification Mark (FIM-A) to envelopes by default. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DefaultHeight
properties.description: Returns or sets the default envelope height, in points. Read/write Single.

properties.name: DefaultWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the default envelope width, in points. Read/write Single.

properties.name: DefaultSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the default envelope size. Read/write String.

properties.name: DefaultOmitReturnAddress
properties.description: True if the return address is omitted from envelopes by default. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FeedSource
properties.description: Returns or sets the paper tray for the envelope. Read/write WdPaperTray.

properties.name: AddressFromLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the left edge of the envelope and the delivery address. Read/write Single.

properties.name: AddressFromTop
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the top edge of the envelope and the delivery address. Read/write Single.

properties.name: ReturnAddressFromLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the left edge of the envelope and the return address. Read/write Single.

properties.name: ReturnAddressFromTop
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance (in points) between the top edge of the envelope and the return address. Read/write Single.

properties.name: AddressStyle
properties.description: Returns a Style object that represents the delivery address style for the envelope. Read-only.

properties.name: ReturnAddressStyle
properties.description: Returns a Style object that represents the return address style for the envelope.

properties.name: DefaultOrientation
properties.description: Returns or sets the default orientation for feeding envelopes. Read/write WdEnvelopeOrientation.

properties.name: DefaultFaceUp
properties.description: True if envelopes are fed face up by default. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Vertical
properties.description: True vertically orients text on Asian envelopes. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RecipientNamefromLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the position, measured in points, of the recipient's name from the left edge of the envelope. Read/write.

properties.name: RecipientNamefromTop
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the position, measured in points, of the recipient's name from the top edge of the envelope. Read/write.

properties.name: RecipientPostalfromLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the position, measured in points, of the recipient's postal code from the left edge of the envelope. Read/write.

properties.name: RecipientPostalfromTop
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the position, measured in points, of the recipient's postal code from the top edge of the envelope. Read/write.

properties.name: SenderNamefromLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the position, measured in points, of the sender's name from the left edge of the envelope. Read/write.

properties.name: SenderNamefromTop
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the position, measured in points, of the sender's name from the top edge of the envelope. Read/write.

properties.name: SenderPostalfromLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the position, measured in points, of the sender's postal code from the left edge of the envelope. Read/write.

properties.name: SenderPostalfromTop
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the position, measured in points, of the sender's postal code from the top edge of the envelope. Read/write.

methods.name: UpdateDocument
methods.description: Updates the envelope in the document with the current envelope settings.

methods.name: Options
methods.description: Displays the Envelope Options dialog box.

methods.name: Insert
methods.signature: Insert([ExtractAddress As Variant], [Address As Variant], [AutoText As Variant], [OmitReturnAddress As Variant], [ReturnAddress As Variant], [ReturnAutoText As Variant], [PrintBarCode As Variant], [PrintFIMA As Variant], [Size As Variant], [Height As Variant], [Width As Variant], [FeedSource As Variant], [AddressFromLeft As Variant], [AddressFromTop As Variant], [ReturnAddressFromLeft As Variant], [ReturnAddressFromTop As Variant], [DefaultFaceUp As Variant], [DefaultOrientation As Variant], [PrintEPostage As Variant], [Vertical As Variant], [RecipientNamefromLeft As Variant], [RecipientNamefromTop As Variant], [RecipientPostalfromLeft As Variant], [RecipientPostalfromTop As Variant], [SenderNamefromLeft As Variant], [SenderNamefromTop As Variant], [SenderPostalfromLeft As Variant], [SenderPostalfromTop As Variant])
methods.description: Inserts an envelope as a separate section at the beginning of the specified document.

parameters.name: ExtractAddress
parameters.description: True to use the text marked by the EnvelopeAddress bookmark (a user-defined bookmark) as the recipient's address.

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: A string that specifies the recipient's address (ignored if ExtractAddress is True).

parameters.name: AutoText
parameters.description: A string that specifies an AutoText entry to use for the address. If specified, Address is ignored.

parameters.name: OmitReturnAddress
parameters.description: True to not insert a return address.

parameters.name: ReturnAddress
parameters.description: A string that specifies the return address.

parameters.name: ReturnAutoText
parameters.description: A string that specifies an AutoText entry to use for the return address. If specified, ReturnAddress is ignored.

parameters.name: PrintBarCode
parameters.description: True to add a POSTNET bar code. For U.S. mail only.

parameters.name: PrintFIMA
parameters.description: True to add a Facing Identification Mark (FIMA) for use in presorting courtesy reply mail. For U.S. mail only.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: A string that specifies the envelope size. The string must match one of the sizes listed in the Envelope size box in the Envelope Options dialog box (for example, "Size 10" or "C4").

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the envelope, measured in points, when the Size argument is set to "Custom size."

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the envelope, measured in points, when the Size argument is set to "Custom size."

parameters.name: FeedSource
parameters.description: True to use the FeedSource property of the Envelope object to specify which paper tray to use when printing the envelope.

parameters.name: AddressFromLeft
parameters.description: The distance, measured in points, between the left edge of the envelope and the recipient's address.

parameters.name: AddressFromTop
parameters.description: The distance, measured in points, between the top edge of the envelope and the recipient's address.

parameters.name: ReturnAddressFromLeft
parameters.description: The distance, measured in points, between the left edge of the envelope and the return address.

parameters.name: ReturnAddressFromTop
parameters.description: The distance, measured in points, between the top edge of the envelope and the return address.

parameters.name: DefaultFaceUp
parameters.description: True to print the envelope face up, False to print it face down.

parameters.name: DefaultOrientation
parameters.description: The orientation for the envelope. Can be any WdEnvelopeOrientation constant.

parameters.name: PrintEPostage
parameters.description: True to insert postage from an Internet postage vendor.

parameters.name: Vertical
parameters.description: True to print vertical text on the envelope. Used for Asian envelopes. Default is False.

parameters.name: RecipientNamefromLeft
parameters.description: Position of the recipient's name, measured in points from the left edge of the envelope. Used for Asian envelopes.

parameters.name: RecipientNamefromTop
parameters.description: Position of the recipient's name, measured in points from the top edge of the envelope. Used for Asian envelopes.

parameters.name: RecipientPostalfromLeft
parameters.description: Position of the recipient's postal code, measured in points from the left edge of the envelope. Used for Asian envelopes.

parameters.name: RecipientPostalfromTop
parameters.description: Position of the recipient's postal code, measured in points from the top edge of the envelope. Used for Asian envelopes.

parameters.name: SenderNamefromLeft
parameters.description: Position of the sender's name, measured in points from the left edge of the envelope. Used for Asian envelopes.

parameters.name: SenderNamefromTop
parameters.description: Position of the sender's name, measured in points from the top edge of the envelope. Used for Asian envelopes.

parameters.name: SenderPostalfromLeft
parameters.description: Position of the sender's postal code, measured in points from the left edge of the envelope. Used for Asian envelopes.

parameters.name: SenderPostalfromTop
parameters.description: Position of the sender's postal code, measured in points from the top edge of the envelope. Used for Asian envelopes.
